verdict.rationale: Runloop documents one product-owned bulk workflow: a single CLI benchmark job that provisions many devboxes, runs agents, scores and aggregates results, and compares multiple agents with one command. Beyond that, the evidence shows parallel capacity and snapshot fan-out, not general bulk operations on resources. missing for 10: general-purpose bulk actions across arbitrary resources (e.g., batch create/suspend/delete devboxes or batch command execution), bulk API/SDK endpoints, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Submit a benchmark job via the CLI and let Runloop handle everything: provisioning devboxes, running agents, scoring results, and aggregating outputs. Compare multiple agents side-by-side with a single command.
Perform fan-out and attempt multiple approaches to a code change.
